faq.q: Where do buildable lots in Tsawwassen come from?
faq.a: New urban lots are created by subdivision against the parcel's zone minimum in Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600 — from 335 m² in RS7 up to 4,000 m² in RS3 — and by added-unit development on existing lots, since Delta allows up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots; on the agricultural edges, a new A1 lot needs 8 ha.

faq.q: Can I subdivide a farm parcel near Tsawwassen?
faq.a: Only within tight limits: in the A1 zone a new lot needs a minimum of 8 ha, Official Community Plan compliance and approval under the Agricultural Land Commission Act where applicable, A3 zoning does not permit subdivision, and reserve land generally needs Agricultural Land Commission permission to subdivide.

faq.q: What extra rules apply to a bluff or beach lot?
faq.a: On the west shore, Development Permit Area SD2 (English Bluff / Tsawwassen Escarpment) addresses mud flows, debris flows, erosion and land slip, with development subject to a Professional Engineer's conditions and a 7.5 m setback from the natural boundary of the sea; on Boundary Bay, SD3 sets a 2.9 m datum floor level, a 2.3 m minimum land surface elevation and a 7.5 m tidal setback.
